Hi there, I think Cooper is cute and want artwork of her!

I would like for her to wear a one-piece competition swimsuit. Black, white, and green are good colors for her swimsuit!

Cooper's hairstyle should be from her sport outfit, but should keep these parts of her bangs: https://files.catbox.moe/hrfurt.jpeg

https://azurlane.koumakan.jp/wiki/File:CooperSport.png

I was wondering if you could draw a landscape piece with a ratio of
16:9 High Quality for stream background!
Could you also separate the background and the drawing of the character?

I would love a cute/sexy summer artwork with my character at the beach!

Can draw however you'd like!
Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SGuAiuJe1aXu3JvK1buzIG_sDScKy4C9?usp=sharing

Hi! I saw your beautiful illustration on the front page and wanted to make a request for my VTuber Character! His name is Syphu. He is a magical deer who is the guardian of nature. He is tasked with spreading happiness and keeping peace on Earth. His personality is gentle, free-spirited, and joyful. He likes nature and animals.

For the specific pose and expression, I will leave it up to you. I would like to request a simple background of trees and be able to separate the background and character if it is ok. Thank you so much for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UqTY0jaPPTkQKAgujk4Q4qfb6xyzPvyy?usp=sharing

Hello. I have been enjoying your lovely paintings from the bottom of my heart.
Your drawings of the various Azur Lane girls are so wonderful that I have been hoping to commission you to draw them for some time.
I would like to commission you to paint "Neptune" from the same work.
I would like her to wear the default outfit or the dress outfit from the most recent dress-up, but if you have another outfit you would like her to wear, that's fine too.
I would be happy to see a sexy or mischievous expression or pose, but I'll leave it up to you. Please draw them as you like.
If possible, a background like a waterfront would be appreciated (even a simple one). (A simple background is also fine.) I would appreciate it if you could take your time.
I would appreciate it if you could draw it slowly. Thank you very much.

I am pondering the name. Dear Sir or Madam
My name is Lilika Kanzaki, and I am a private Vtuber.
I would like to send you a request to draw myself.

I would like to draw myself.
I would like an illustration of Lirika Kanzaki, a VTuber who loves to be goofy and cute and is a member of the "Chemomimi" school discipline committee!
If you can let me hold a gun, I will leave the other themes and poses up to you.
We would like to use it as a thumbnail,
　I would appreciate it if you could draw the top of her head and the area around her face so that I can use them as thumbnails.
We would be very happy if you could add facial expressions to the extent possible!
　(Please don't be too hard on us!).

(Please don't be unreasonable!) [Intended use
Use on social networking services such as Twitter.
Use on our monetized YouTube channel
Use in FANBOX

Delivery format
We apologize for the inconvenience.
We would greatly appreciate it if you could provide us with PSD data in which the person, background, address, etc. are layered!


I am very embarrassed to say that I do not yet have a three-view drawing, so I would appreciate it if you could refer to the full-body image in the tree of my fixed tweets on Twitter.

Thank you very much for your cooperation.
